name: audit
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && for f in receipts/*.json.gz; do echo INPUT="$f"; bun research/track-m/audit-lane-b-cost.ts "$f" receipts/family.json || exit; done

name: check
cmd: bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh && bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check

name: projection
cmd: for d in projection/lane-b-{range-pair,early-focus,range-followup}-v1/receipts/*; do mkdir -p "$d/raw"; tar -xzf "$d/receipts.tar.gz" -C "$d/raw" || exit; done; LANE_B_PROJECTION_ROOT=projection bun research/track-m/summarize-lane-b-focus.ts || exit; out=$(mktemp -d); cp projection/lane-b-early-focus-v1/summary.json "$out/summary.json"; bash research/track-m/pack-section18-archive.sh "$out"
